reviews.title: Awesome, Great quality budget fans.
reviews.comment: Built a cheap gaming pc and decided to go with this fan/controller set as the price was great and it looks great in the build, but I’m honestly surprised with them, they are quiet and move air thru the case really well, I also paired it with their air cooler and it has been super stable with great thermals. Lots of RGB settings to choose from as well
reviews.author: Jamison

reviews.title: Best at this price range!
reviews.comment: I really can't believe this Fan set's price, it's simply fantastic! Really good airflow, incredibly quiet, more RGB, single or combined color and brightness options than you could ever possibly want, good cable length on the fans, a fan hub to connect all the fans to with a SATA power connnector and a remote control for your lighting preference! You really can't ask for more at this price, and yes, I'm aware that the fan hub does not connect to the RGB header of your motherboard so that you can control the lights via software directly from your PC, but then again, I refer you once more to the price. Want that feature? Go up 2 or 3 levels higher in price and you'll be set, but at this price range? Best in class, bar none. Five Stars! :-)
reviews.author: Alejandro Javier P

reviews.title: DOPE
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D13AGHx8NoL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/514QC+HUVWL._SY256.jpg These fans are seriously impressive—I’m not easily wowed, but these delivered. Installation was incredibly simple with no extra wiring, and they powered directly through the hard drive without any hassle.
The airflow, noise level, and lighting are all excellent. They offer great performance and look fantastic, especially for the price. I originally bought them for my son’s build, but I’ll definitely be purchasing more for future builds.
My only concern is the remote—if it gets lost, you won’t be able to control the fan speed. The RGB app works well for changing colors, but it doesn’t replace the remote for speed adjustments.
reviews.author: Amanda O’Neill

reviews.title: So much more than I expected!
reviews.comment: It is so rare to receive something that you've ordered, and it turns out to be so much more than you expected or paid for.  This was definitely the case when unpacking this order that was very nicely boxed and the 5 fans were very sturdy and well made.  I was also pleasantly surprised that it came with a very nice 10 port hub and multiple function remote even though there was no mention of either in the description when I purchased it.  Installed all 5 fans in no time and at first thought that the fan speeds were nowhere near what was in the description until I realized that you could increase/decrease the fan speeds with the remote control that was included.  Definitely recommed.
reviews.author: Rodney Rea

reviews.title: Cheap. Gets the job done.
reviews.comment:
Decided to replace the stock fans on one of my pcs. Normally, I go noctua and control each fan through the MB headers with Fan Control. But this pc isn't that important and was missing some rgb bling. I knocked down a star because the fans use some kind of old serial cable with like 6 pins, these are never going to connect to your motherboard needless to say. You HAVE to use the included fan hub, the fan hub has a RGB connector so it can connect to and receive RGB signal from the MB but that hasn't worked at all. [knocked half a star for that] and lastly, you will not be able to control the fan speed and set fan curves or any of that stuff which is quite important in my opinion [knocked a half star for that ]
The hub is pretty ugly and clunky, but can accommodate a large amount of fans , up to 10 i think. Wish it was simpler, maybe just the board and that way i could hide it in the rear panel. Hub connects directly to the PSU via SATA power.
As far as sound. its great! Chuggs along pretty silently and you can manually adjust the fan speed [ as a whole ] with the remote. The ring led is nice at a distance or while in rainbow mode, static colors show where the LED is just cause the diffusor material isnt the greatest. Overall you cant go wrong with this. This wouldve been amazing for my first build years ago . There are better fan and hub sets out there, but none that give you as much bang for your buck as these.
reviews.author: Carlos Ortiz
